comments:
Inkluso is an automated website checker. It runs axe-core 4.12.1 in a real Chromium render and tests against WCAG 2.1 Level A and AA. WCAG 2.2 target size and best-practice rules are reported separately.

Automated testing covers roughly 30 to 40% of WCAG success criteria. Every report separates automated findings from what needs a human check, and a result is a dated record of an automated scan, not a certification.

The free scan checks one page and needs no account. A public sample report is at https://inkluso.eu/sample . Our accessibility statement: https://inkluso.eu/accessibility-statement-en

Interface languages: Czech, German, Polish, Slovak, English (a Dutch interface is also live). Support contact: the address shown on https://inkluso.eu/legal
features: Inkluso runs axe-core 4.12.1 in a real Chromium render against WCAG 2.1 A and AA; WCAG 2.2 target size and best-practice checks reported apart. Free one-page scan; paid audit up to 100 pages. Each finding cites the WCAG criterion, the EN 301 549 clause and a provision of one chosen national act (DE, AT, CZ, PL or SK). Reports: de, cs, pl, en, sk.
title: Inkluso
